The AI Infrastructure GPU Delivery team is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering the infrastructure that powers Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's rapidly expanding AI and GPU portfolio. The organization partners closely with Engineering, Cloud Platform, Networking, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Data Center Operations, Observability, Finance, Business Operations, hardware partners, and senior leadership to deliver highly complex infrastructure programs at global scale.

As a Principal Program Manager
, you will oversee the planning, execution, and operational readiness of strategic AI infrastructure and GPU delivery initiatives. You will be responsible for translating complex technical and operational requirements into integrated execution plans, establishing governance frameworks, driving cross-functional alignment, and ensuring successful delivery across multiple concurrent programs. This role requires the ability to influence across organizations, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive executive decision-making without direct authority.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end execution of complex AI infrastructure and GPU delivery programs, from strategic planning and deployment readiness through operational handoff.
Identify, prioritize, and successfully execute a broad portfolio of cross-functional initiatives while managing multiple programs concurrently.
Develop and maintain integrated program plans that define milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, owners, key decisions, and committed actions.
Coordinate delivery across Engineering, Cloud Platform, Networking, SRE, Data Center Operations, Observability, Finance, Business Operations, hardware partners, and executive leadership.
Establish and lead program operating mechanisms, including weekly execution reviews, readiness assessments, governance forums, executive business reviews, and cross-functional planning sessions.
Monitor GPU fleet readiness, deployment progress, operational health, service availability, and reliability across current and next-generation AI platforms.
Manage deployment governance, operational readiness reviews, stakeholder transitions, and change management processes to ensure successful service delivery.
Navigate complex dependencies across organizations, resolve execution risks, drive mitigation plans, and ensure accountability through program completion.
Serve as the primary escalation point between engineering and operations to accelerate issue resolution and remove execution blockers.
Establish structured incident management processes, including root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action tracking, and verification of long-term resolutions.
Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards that communicate program health, operational KPIs, customer impact, dependencies, financial status, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions.
Partner with Observability and Telemetry teams to improve visibility into GPU health, network fabric performance, RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, and overall service health.
Collaborate with internal engineering organizations and external hardware partners to improve deployment quality, operational efficiency, and time to resolution.
Establish scalable program management frameworks, documentation standards, runbooks, playbooks, onboarding materials, and repeatable delivery processes.
Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI-assisted workflows, data-driven decision making, validation frameworks, version readiness, and operational optimization.
Build and maintain consistent reporting, scorecards, KPIs, and program metrics to support executive decision-making and portfolio management.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of seven years of program management, product management, technical project management, or related experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated experience managing complex technical programs involving infrastructure, cloud services, networking, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent programs while effectively managing competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Strong experience partnering with cross-functional technical and business organizations to deliver strategic initiatives.
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, scorecards, and data-driven program insights to support operational and business decisions.
Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance frameworks, operating cadences, and standardized program management processes.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
Proven ability to work effectively in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments while driving accountability and execution across organizations without direct authority.
Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU deployments, cloud infrastructure, data center operations, networking, observability, or large-scale distributed systems is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:

Position Overview

Autodesk Forma is on a mission to improve the built environment to meet the needs of humanity and the climate. By combining AI, 3D, cloud collaboration, and automation, we help customers explore more sustainable, affordable, and efficient solutions to some of the challenges facing the built environment.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager
to join Forma Design and help us turn complex, cross-organization initiatives into clear, coordinated execution.

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders and teams across Forma and Autodesk. You will be a key counterpart to Technical Program Managers across the broader organization, helping translate cross-organizational requirements and dependencies into a way of working that fits Forma Design.

This is not simply a project-tracking role. You will create a structure that allows teams to move effectively: clarifying goals and ownership, connecting dependencies, identifying risks, facilitating decisions, and ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time.

You will operate across different levels of the organization, from delivery teams to Product and Engineering leaders accountable for key programs and initiatives. You will be expected to navigate complex technical and program discussions independently, quickly understand their context and implications, and turn that complexity into clear, decision-ready information for leaders and stakeholders.

Forma Design teams operate with significant autonomy. Success in this role therefore requires someone who can bring clarity and accountability without adding unnecessary processes or taking ownership away from teams.

Responsibilities

jobs.title: Post Boost Branch Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

What’s it like to work at BAE Systems? It’s the feeling of knowing your strategic oversight and analytical precision are directly securing the future of national defense on one of the most complex "mega-projects" in the world.

Our teams provide the critical advisory and assistance services needed to modernize the U.S. ICBM weapon system. As a Program Manager, you will embark on a high-impact career supporting the LGM-35A Sentinel. In this job, you will serve as a vital link within the Post Boost Branch, providing the technical and programmatic oversight necessary to ensure the Prime Contractor and sub-tier suppliers meet the rigorous demands of the nation's next-generation ICBM.

Your Responsibilities

As a Program Manager, Your Primary Goal Is To Synchronize The Efforts Of The Prime Contractor (NG) And Key Suppliers (Aerojet) To Ensure The Post Boost Systems Are Delivered On Time And Within Budget. Your Day-to-day Functions Will Include

Strategic Oversight & Comparison: Conducting comprehensive status comparisons between Prime and Sub-contractor PMRs; analyzing discrepancies in dates and deliverables to ensure alignment across the supply chain.
Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA): Analyzing Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) and conducting SRA to identify critical path risks, relaying findings to stakeholders to prevent program slips.
Logistics & Lifecycle Analysis: Consolidating complex logistics data, including LCSP, aging/surveillance, and spares data, ensuring alignment with production schedules and cost reporting.
Financial Fidelity: Providing cost support for "life of type" buys and long-lead materials, working closely with Financial Management (FM) to increase the accuracy and fidelity of cost data.
Supplier Management: Leading analysis of sub-tier supplier processes and evaluating alternate PBPS suppliers, including the management of RFAs and contractual execution requirements.
Technical Coordination: Consolidating and tracking critical notes, questions, and action items ahead of major reviews to ensure all stakeholders are aligned and accountable.
Sustainment Planning: Collecting and analyzing PBACM "age out" data and Programmed Depot Maintenance requirements to ensure long-term system viability.

Who You Are

Your Role

The Data Management team designs and delivers innovative cloud data platforms and services that enable enterprise decision-making and business outcomes. The Technical Program Manager, Principal reports to the Sr. Manager, Data Management & Integration Management and plays a critical role in defining, driving and evolving the commercialization and operationalization strategy for cloud-based data products and services. You will coordinate complex dependencies, manage program risks and milestones, facilitate decision-making, and provide leadership visibility into commercialization progress, readiness, and outcomes. Your Work

Define and evolve commercialization operating models, governance structures, and strategic roadmaps to support long-term platform growth and service adoption.

Partner with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage the department Finance Budget, including budget planning, forecasting, variance tracking, and spend governance in support of program and commercialization priorities

Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and execution across technical, operational, financial, and business domains while influencing decisions across multiple organizations.

Experience supporting commercialization, operationalization, service delivery, platform adoption, or large-scale business transformation initiatives preferred.

Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.

You own the end-to-end delivery of consumer lending, third-party origination, and home loan program initiatives, using data, insight, and strong governance to ensure programs launch smoothly, operate effectively, and perform as intended. You clearly communicate business outcomes to technical teams to support solution design and lead cross-functional teams to accomplish shared objectives. You are a trusted partner to leaders, internal teams, vendors, and third-party lending partners who balances innovation, operational execution, regulatory compliance, risk management, and member experience in a highly regulated financial services environment. You proactively solve problems, influence decisions with subject matter expertise, and drive improvements in lending systems, workflows, partner channels, product delivery, controls, and member offering in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and enterprise-level impact.

What You'll Do

Program and Project Management: Lead and guide cross-functional teams to deliver consumer lending, third-party origination, and home loan program initiatives on time, within scope, and within budget. Responsibilities include developing business cases, collecting and documenting business requirements, conducting research, coordinating vendor due diligence, supporting contract review, managing dependencies, ensuring quality user acceptance testing, overseeing implementations, and supporting post-launch stabilization.
Strategy Development: Partner with senior management and business leaders to develop and implement strategic plans, product roadmaps, lending program enhancements, and channel strategies that align with credit union objectives, responsible growth, operational capacity, member needs, and enterprise priorities.
Risk Management and Governance: Work closely with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Technology, Finance, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor risks associated with lending programs, vendor relationships, third-party origination channels, member communications, systems, processes, and regulatory requirements.
Member and Partner Experience: Focus on enhancing member satisfaction, partner experience, and operational consistency through improved lending journeys, clearer communications, streamlined workflows, digital capabilities, and effective support for direct, indirect, third-party, and home lending channels.

Ensure programs, workflows, communications, and vendor activities adhere to applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and committee or governance expectations.
Resource and Budget Planning: Manage resources efficiently to optimize program outcomes. Plan, organize, direct, and monitor budgetary activity for upcoming projects, vendor work, system enhancements, partner integrations, operational readiness activities, and lending program initiatives.
Performance Measurement: Track, evaluate, and report program status, adoption, operational outcomes, member impacts, partner performance, risk indicators, and benefits realization. Use data-driven insights to identify improvement opportunities and recommend corrective action where necessary.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including internal teams, senior management, members, vendors, third-party originators, technology partners, and external service providers. Collaborate across Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Marketing, Finance, Branch, Contact Center, Servicing, and vendor teams to gather requirements, define specifications, prioritize enhancements, resolve issues, and support successful execution. Act as a subject matter expert on consumer lending, home lending, and third-party origination programs.
Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, digital lending capabilities, regulatory changes, partner models, and market practices that impact consumer lending and home loan programs. Recommend, update, and create programs, strategies, workflows, controls, reporting, and stand-alone applications to support long-term credit union growth and operational maturity.
Team Leadership: Provide guidance and support to project teams, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
Third-Party Origination and Vendor Oversight: Support onboarding, ongoing relationship management, performance monitoring, due diligence coordination, issue resolution, documentation, and maintenance activities for third-party lending partners, fintech providers, origination channels, system vendors, and other external partners supporting consumer and home lending programs.

Online New Account Program Administration: Support program design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization for mortgage, home equity, HELOC, affordable housing, specialty lending, and related home loan initiatives, including system requirements, process changes, disclosure impacts, operational readiness, reporting, and cross-functional coordination.
Operational Readiness and Change Management: Develop and support implementation plans, training coordination, communication plans, process documentation, procedure updates, launch readiness materials, escalation paths, and adoption support to ensure sustainable program execution.
Represent credit union in contacts with business and trade associations, members, and regulatory agencies. Attend business functions, industry conferences, and otherwise promote the credit union’s image.

equivalent work experience

Company Description

Prodapt Consulting, formerly known as VDVL Consultants, is a specialized ICT consultancy firm focused on the Telecom and Internet industry since 1987. The organization is recognized for implementing complex changes and innovations in close collaboration with customers and business partners. Its professionals combine a strong passion for technology with a clear understanding of social, economic, and market developments. Prodapt Consulting offers a dynamic environment where experienced consultants can contribute to high-impact digital transformation projects for leading telecom and internet providers.

Role Description

The Project Manager – Data Migration will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex data migration projects within the Telecom and Internet domain. This full-time, on-site role based in Greater London involves managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new platforms, ensuring data quality, integrity, security, and business continuity throughout the transition.

The person in this role will manage project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, risks, and dependencies while coordinating business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, and external partners. They will translate business and technical requirements into actionable migration plans, oversee delivery from discovery through go-live and post-migration support, and ensure successful integration into client environments.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and manage integrated project plans covering data discovery, profiling, mapping, cleansing, transformation, loading, validation, and reconciliation.
* Coordinate data engineers, migration specialists, application teams, testers, business users, and third-party suppliers.
* Agree migration scope, acceptance criteria, ownership, and sign-off responsibilities with business and technical stakeholders.
* Manage dependencies between source systems, target platforms, interfaces, and wider transformation programmes.
* Oversee trial migrations and testing to validate migration processes, data accuracy, completeness, and readiness.
* Plan and coordinate cutover rehearsals, production migration, rollback arrangements, and go-live readiness reviews.
* Track budgets, milestones, risks, issues, and changes, providing clear reporting and timely escalation.
* Ensure appropriate data protection, security, auditability, and compliance controls throughout delivery.
* Coordinate post-migration support, resolve outstanding issues, and transition ownership to operational teams.
* Capture lessons learned and improve data migration delivery practices.

Qualifications

* Proven project management experience delivering complex data migration projects, ideally within Telecom, Internet, or the broader ICT sector.
* Strong understanding of the data migration lifecycle, including ETL/ELT, data mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Experience managing migrations involving databases, cloud data platforms, CRM, billing, ERP, or telecom BSS/OSS systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret migration metrics and drive evidence-based decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across business, technical, and senior leadership teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, resources, suppliers, risks, and cross-project dependencies.
* Effective team leadership skills, including coaching and coordinating multidisciplinary delivery teams.
* Proficiency in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project.
* Familiarity with data governance, GDPR, and secure handling of sensitive customer and business data.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications are an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Greater London within a fast-paced, client-focused consultancy environment.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Field Installations
jobs.description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Join us on the Installations team as Project Manager, Field Installations, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. Start your journey with Anova today!

You’ll own delivery of Anova’s largest multi-site customer installation rollouts, from signed order to devices installed, live, and reporting. As the customer’s single point of contact during each rollout, you’ll turn every commitment into a clear plan, a realistic schedule, and a weekly status update the customer can count on. You’ll lead a small dispatch and coordination team based in the U.S. and Europe, and partner closely with Regional Leads, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Engineering, and Finance, reporting to the Field Installation Program Manager. Success in this role is measured by on-time milestone delivery, faster time from order to live devices, installs done right the first time, and a strong, engaged dispatch team.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Own delivery of assigned large and multi-site customer rollouts from handoff through closeout, serving as the customer’s single point of contact throughout
Build a project plan for each rollout covering scope, site list, sequencing, milestones, materials, resources, and dependencies
Lead customer kickoffs, weekly status meetings, and progress reporting, keeping timelines, risks, and open issues visible to customers and internal stakeholders
Manage scope changes through a documented change process
Confirm site data, access, equipment details, and customer contacts before work is scheduled, so installers arrive with everything they need
Coordinate with Production and Operations so devices, accessories, and materials arrive at each site ahead of installers
Track first-time-right installs and repeat visits by project, partnering with Regional Leads to fix root causes and improve future plans
Route activation, connectivity, and device issues to Hardware and Software Engineering and track them to resolution
Lead, coach, and develop the dispatch and coordination team, setting daily priorities, running daily status recaps, and holding regular 1:1s
Own field installation work calendars and crew assignments, ensuring efficient routing and full use of installer and contractor capacity
Establish standard work for the team, including trackers, daily customer updates, contractor inventory, and accurate project data
Validate contractor invoices against completed installs before approval
Partner with Sales and Customer Success on scope, start dates, and customer expectations before commitments are made, and plan crews weekly with Regional Leads
Close out each project by confirming devices are installed, activated, and reporting, delivering final documentation, and handing the account off to Customer Success

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Minimum Requirements -

2+ years of project management experience in field services, installation, construction, telecommunications, utilities, or a related operational environment
Proven experience delivering multi-site projects for external customers, including project plans, schedules, status reporting, and change control
2+ years of experience leading or supervising a team, such as dispatch, scheduling, coordination, or field teams
Strong customer communication skills, including running status meetings with senior customer contacts
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, IF statements, pivot tables) and experience with scheduling or project management tools
Proven ability to manage several projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to travel up to 25% based on project needs, including occasional multi-day trips for customer kickoffs and site visits
Valid driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications -

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline
PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification
Experience in industrial IoT, telemetry, tank monitoring, or propane and fuel distribution
Experience scheduling and managing third-party contractors
Experience with field service management or dispatch software, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project
Experience working in a matrix organization where influence and collaboration matter as much as direct authority

Physical Requirements -

Ability to perform typical office tasks, including sitting for extended periods, using a computer and mobile devices, and communicating effectively in meetings and presentations
Ability to stand and walk at customer sites and field locations, including outdoor conditions, and occasionally lift up to 25 lbs.

About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: All Source Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Amentum has an opportunity for a highly skilled All-Source Intelligence Analyst
to support Marine Forces Pacific (MARFORPAC) Analysis and Production section. The US PACOM Area of Responsibility (AOR) presents the most complex pacing challenges, driving an unprecedented demand for continuous, high-fidelity, all-source intelligence to support MARFORPAC, Joint Forces Maritime Component Commander (JFMCC), and Joint Task Force (JTF) operational priorities.

The position will serve as an essential force multiplier, fusing multi-intelligence data (GEOINT, SIGINT, OSINT, CI/HUMINT) into actionable, predictive intelligence that directly drives Joint Intelligence Preparation of the Operating Environment (JIPOE) and shapes theater Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance, and Targeting (ISR-T) operations. This position plays a crucial part in developing and executing intelligence strategies that directly support US PACOM priorities and enhance regional security.

Primary Roles and Responsibilities:

Conduct continuous, all-source intelligence analysis focusing on adversary order of battle, capabilities, and intentions within the PACOM Area of Responsibility (AOR).
Support the daily intelligence cycle for Marine Corps Forces Pacific by drafting, reviewing, and disseminating daily intelligence summaries (INTSUMs), briefs, and tailored assessments.
Drive JIPOE and provide analytical support to theater ISR-T operations, activities, and investments (OAIs).
Fuse reporting from various intelligence disciplines to create comprehensive intelligence products for Marine Expeditionary Forces (MEF) in joint, theater, and combined OAIs.
Serve as an analytical liaison, sharing critical intelligence and threat warnings with PACOM, Component Commands, Numbered Fleets, Headquarters Marine Corps (HQMC), and Coalition/Partner units.

Minimum Requirements:

About Infinite Global

Infinite Global is an international communications firm specializing in PR, Content & Campaigns, and Crisis & Litigation. Our clients are ambitious, complex organizations that need to engage with sophisticated audiences. We provide the experience, skills and insight to drive brands forward and, in special situations, to deploy strategies to defend clients from reputational risk.

We serve knowledge-intensive firms, with a focus on the legal and financial services sectors. Some of the world’s largest, most profitable and most specialized law firms and financial services firms look to us for a nuanced understanding of their businesses, a clear sense of the kinds of stories that make news, and tested knowledge of when and how to engage the media.

Our unwavering client focus sets us apart and our approach and success earns accolades from our clients and peers. We are consistently named among PR News’ “Agency Elite” and “Top Places to Work in PR” and have been recognized as the “Best PR Firm” by the National Law Journal seven times.

What we’re looking for

A researcher with a year or more of PR agency experience, ready to work with real independence. The Research Analyst plays an integral role in the design, management and execution of primary, secondary and digital analytics research projects that support key clients, strategic initiatives and business development efforts.

You will translate complex data sets and media landscapes into clear, compelling narratives for client teams and senior advisors, delivering nuanced, actionable insights rather than raw output. This is a role for a proactive, intellectually curious contributor who takes ownership of research workstreams, raises the quality of deliverables, and helps push the agency’s research capabilities forward.

Ideal candidates will bring one to three years of relevant research, analytics or communications experience, hands-on command of the major monitoring and social listening platforms, and a working understanding of PR measurement frameworks. Prior experience in a PR agency or professional services environment is strongly preferred.

This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in our New York City office. Candidates must live within commuting distance.

What you’d do

Research and analysis

Lead comprehensive research projects on companies, industries, markets, competitors, journalists and key executives.
Synthesize findings into objective, actionable insights presented in concise, compelling formats, including research reports, competitive audits, reputation analyses and measurement dashboards.
Support the development and refinement of media measurement frameworks, helping client teams define KPIs aligned with communications and business objectives.
Assist in the preparation of new business proposals and marketing materials, contributing research-backed insights that strengthen the agency’s pitch efforts.

Monitoring, measurement and intelligence

Independently manage media monitoring and social listening programs for client accounts.
Analyze news and social media coverage for key metrics, including tone, topic, share of voice, messaging effectiveness, spokespeople and outlet type.
Monitor media outlets, social platforms and emerging channels for trends, developments and insights that affect clients and their competitive landscape; proactively surface opportunities for client teams.
Identify and monitor relevant industry events, regulatory developments and market trends; gather and disseminate intelligence to relevant client teams and executives.
Support the crisis team with real-time monitoring of client mentions and the timely creation of situation reports.

Databases, media lists and tools

Maintain and evolve databases of media contacts, journalist coverage patterns and competitor intelligence; ensure the accuracy and currency of all records.
Build and maintain targeted media lists in support of client pitching and strategic communications programs.
Maintain current knowledge of research tools, platforms and methodologies, including AI-powered analytics tools, and commit to continuous learning as they evolve.

Why we want you

You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
You have one to three years of relevant research, analytics or communications experience; prior PR agency or professional services experience is strongly preferred.
You have strong analytical capabilities and experience working across quantitative and qualitative data sets, with proficiency in Excel and/or data visualization tools such as Tableau or Google Data Studio.
You have hands-on experience with a broad suite of PR and research platforms, including media monitoring tools (Propel, Cision, Meltwater, Mention or equivalents), social listening platforms (Pulsar, Brandwatch, Sprinklr or equivalents), and media databases and news intelligence tools (LexisNexis or equivalents).
You are familiar with AI-powered research and analytics tools, and genuinely interested in how emerging technologies are reshaping PR measurement and media intelligence.
You have a demonstrated understanding of PR measurement frameworks, including earned media value, share of voice, sentiment analysis and audience segmentation.
You know AP style.

What we offer

Exposure across the agency: research touches client counsel, new business and crisis work, so you see how the whole firm operates.
Opportunity to work with leading law firms and professional services firms on a global scale within an international network.
A focus on growth and professional development: twice annual professional planning sessions, regular access to leadership and mentorship opportunities.
Hybrid work schedule; two days in the office with three optional work-from-home days per week.
$175 one-time stipend for your at-home work set-up; $50 monthly stipend for your smartphone contract and a stipend to upgrade your device every three years.
Competitive salary and customizable benefits package including: 100% company paid health, dental and vision insurance coverage; 401k with competitive company match; monthly benefit stipend that can be used for health and wellness, transportation, student loan repayment or charitable contributions; Employee Assistance Program and free annual membership to the Calm app.
Ample time off: 15 vacation days, 10 annual company holidays, nine days paid sick leave, one personal day and an “on call” period between Christmas and New Year’s.
Unlimited paid time off to volunteer and 100% matching of charitable contributions up to $1,000 per year.
Thorough onboarding and training process that extends throughout your tenure with the company.

Hybrid Role: Minimum of 2 days on-site in Vienna, VA

Salary: 55K - 75K

ActioNet has an opening for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level Security Analyst to support and strengthen the organization's information security program. This individual will assist with identifying and tracking security vulnerabilities, monitoring security events, supporting incident response activities, administering security awareness initiatives, and maintaining security metrics and reporting.

The Security Analyst will work closely with IT and other business teams to investigate potential security risks, recommend security improvements, coordinate remediation efforts, and track corrective actions. The analyst will also maintain system security documentation and gather evidence for audits and assessments.

This position is ideal for someone looking to develop their cybersecurity career through hands-on experience with enterprise security tools, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, and security awareness programs.

Key Responsibilities:

Vulnerability Management
Conduct weekly reviews of identified vulnerabilities and security recommendations within the Microsoft Defender portal.
Evaluate vulnerabilities and Microsoft security recommendations to understand potential security risks and determine appropriate remediation recommendations.
Research potential solutions and recommended remediation approaches for identified vulnerabilities.
Coordinate with IT to communicate remediation requirements and track implementation efforts.
Monitor remediation progress to ensure identified vulnerabilities are addressed.
Maintain accurate documentation of identified vulnerabilities, remediation recommendations, and resolution status.
Security Monitoring & Incident Response
Monitor the IT Security mailbox for Microsoft Defender alerts, suspicious activity, and user-reported security concerns.
Review and investigate security events to determine potential risks and whether escalation or incident declaration is necessary.
Follow established incident response procedures when investigating and documenting security events.
Maintain incident documentation and supporting evidence in SharePoint.
Coordinate with IT to investigate and resolve security-related issues.
Conduct weekly reviews of Microsoft Defender dashboards to identify ongoing security activities, emerging threats, and potential areas of concern.
Review relevant threat intelligence and communicate potential security concerns to appropriate personnel.
Escalate suspicious activity and potential security incidents in accordance with established procedures.
Assist with planning and conducting incident response tabletop exercises, document lessons learned, and track follow-up actions.
Email Security & Security Awareness
Administer the organization's Ironscales email security platform.
Review and investigate user-submitted phishing emails through the IT Security mailbox.
Analyze submitted emails and take appropriate action within the Ironscales platform.
Assist with administering quarterly security awareness and phishing simulation campaigns.
Monitor employee training completion and phishing simulation results.
Follow up on unsuccessful training or simulation activities and coordinate additional training or required follow-up.
Prepare and distribute security awareness metrics to Quality Assurance (QA) and IT management.
Continuous Monitoring, Security Metrics & Reporting
Support continuous monitoring by assisting with periodic account and access reviews and reviewing system security documentation and control implementation. Document findings and track corrective actions through completion.
Prepare recurring security metrics and reports to support visibility into the organization's security posture.
Maintain reporting schedules and ensure reports are completed accurately and on time.
Compile, review, and communicate security performance metrics to support internal and external audits.
Identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for security improvement.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, OR at least 2 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, IT operations, or security operations. Relevant coursework and certifications will also be considered.
Foundational understanding of information security principles, including vulnerability management, endpoint security, threat detection, and incident response.
Familiarity with Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, and general IT environments.
Basic understanding of networking concepts, operating system security, and common cybersecurity threats.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and investigate technical issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Bureau of Exchange Application Support provides consumer support for individuals who apply for health insurance coverage through the NY State of Health Marketplace System and the new Medicaid Eligibility Client Management system (MECM). Manages multiple units of subordinate staff working on operational tasks, appeals, systems work, reporting and/or quality assurance.

Oversee staff assignments, productivity, quality assurance activities and evaluates performance

Oversee the direction of staff in responding to eligibility and enrollment-related intra and inter-agency correspondence, letters, telephone calls, and emails from consumers, stakeholders, oversight agencies, federal staff, members of the legislature, and health care provider community.

Work closely with subordinate staff to identify training needs, develop trainings, and oversee the provision of training

Manages and directs program activities by setting priorities and deadlines.

Works directly with the Department’s system contractors to resolve system related issues

Prepares and reviews reports of program activities that inform planning activities.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Reassignment: Current NYS Department of Health employee with permanent or contingent permanent status as an EligibilityProgram Manager 1, G-27.

New York State employee with one or more years of permanent or contingent-permanent service in title at Grade 25 or above,and eligible for transfer to Eligibility Program Manager 1, G-27,under section 70.1 or 52.6 of the Civil Service Law.

This title is part of the New York Hiring for Emergency Limited Placement Statewide Program (NY HELPS). HELPS Program titles may be filled via a noncompetitive

appointment. This means that you do not need to take an exam to qualify, but you do need to meet the minimum qualifications of the title.

Eight years of professional experience*, two years of which must have included second-level supervision of staff, performing one or more of the following seven activities in a program with one or more of the following functions: provides reimbursements for health care services; works with social services program areas; determines eligibility for a consumer assisted program in a hospital or other health care facility; provides health care regulatory oversight; or performs quality assurance and interpretation/application of standards of health care.

Activities

Overseeing and directing staff in determining eligibility for a health insurance program or consumer assisted program in which financial eligibility criteria must be met.
Overseeing and directing staff in performing utilization review,including prepayment or post-payment review of requested health care services, prior approval or authorization activities, adjudication or pricing of claims for payment, or analysis of patterns of health care.
Overseeing and directing staff in developing mechanisms for the reimbursement and financing of health care services,including rate-setting or approval, capitation reimbursement methodologies, fee schedule development, coding constructs for medical goods and services, or application and processing ofreimbursement methodologies.
Administering and overseeing staff responsible for day to day program operations for budgeting, staffing, or programplanning.

Overseeing and directing staff in planning, designing, developing, researching, or evaluating proposals to establish or refine health related programs, with responsibility for interpreting legislation or regulations, defining and describing target populations and local demographics, grant and proposalwriting, or developing, reviewing, and evaluating contracts.
Administering and overseeing staff responsible for performing quality assurance activities such as ensuring compliance with laws, rules, regulations, and policies, as it pertains to activities 1through 6.
A Bachelor's Degree can substitute for four years of experience; a Master's Degree can substitute for five years of experience.

Preferred Qualifications: Preferred candidates will have professional experience in public health insurance programs, including New York’s Medicaid, Child Health Plus, Essential Plan, and Qualified Health Plans. Preferred candidates will also have excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong analytical skills and attention to detail; strong organizational skills; proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Access); the ability to work well independently and as part of a team, and to manage multiple priorities in order to meet deadlines; and experience using electronic data systems.

When reviewing qualifications, omissions and vagueness cannot be interpreted in the candidate’s favor. Candidates are responsible for providing accurate and clear descriptions of their experience demonstrating how they meet the minimum qualifications.

As the single point of contact for the Government contracting team, you will own the integrated schedule, manage dependencies that span Government-furnished systems and AI platform access, and run the team's Agile cadence as Scrum Master to keep delivery on track. As a Project Manager, you manage and integrate multiple projects to deliver a single, impactful outcome. You operate independently, providing world-class service that drives account growth and ensures positive net customer retention across all assigned project offices. Coordinate production go-live, training, and handover with the team to ensure a smooth transition to operations and sustained platform success.

Contributing to positive net customer retention, reinforcing the organization’s reputation for excellence in the account industry, project assigned.

Preferred Experience

Federal budget oversight or grants-management programs involving funding announcements, 2 CFR 200, or Grants.gov.
Delivery inside an on-premises or closed-network Government environment.
Background delivering AI/ML or LLM-enabled products with human-in-the-loop review workflows.

Current or active Top Secret clearance (T5), in access within the last 24 months

Umbra's ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms). new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about using intelligence analysis to solve complex challenges in the space domain?

Do you enjoy turning intelligence from multiple sources into actionable data that can inform modeling, simulation, and analysis?

Are you interested in working alongside engineers, modelers, and analysts to help assess and forecast national security space threats?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking a Space All-Source Intelligence Analyst to support programs within APL's National Security Space Mission Area (NSSMA). You will apply your knowledge of the Intelligence Community (IC) and experience with all-source intelligence analysis to help address critical challenges facing the Department of Defense (DoD) and Intelligence Community in the space domain.

In this role, you will serve as a critical link between intelligence and the technical teams developing high-fidelity modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) capabilities. Rather than focusing primarily on traditional intelligence reporting, you will acquire, analyze, and translate intelligence from multiple classified sources into the quantitative data, parameters, and operational context needed to develop realistic models and simulations. You will collaborate closely with systems engineers, modelers, data scientists, and program teams to ensure our analyses accurately represent real-world threats and operating environments.

As a Space All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you will...

Acquire, analyze, and synthesize intelligence from multiple sources and classified disciplines to develop a comprehensive understanding of space threats and operational environments.
Translate qualitative intelligence assessments into quantitative data, variables, and parameters that can be incorporated into modeling, simulation, and analysis tools.
Collaborate with systems engineers and modelers to integrate intelligence into high-fidelity models used to assess and forecast national security space threats.
Apply intelligence insights to develop realistic operational and training scenarios for complex simulations.
Support model verification and validation by comparing simulation results with available real-world intelligence and identifying discrepancies that may affect model accuracy or fidelity.
Develop and maintain detailed threat and operational environment profiles to ensure models and simulations reflect the most current intelligence available.
Work closely with MS&A engineers, data scientists, analysts, and program managers to define intelligence requirements and effectively integrate intelligence throughout the modeling and analysis lifecycle.
Communicate intelligence findings and technical insights to multidisciplinary teams to support analyses, assessments, and sponsor needs.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

B.S. in Intelligence Studies, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Data Science or equivalent experience.
At least 5 years of experience in DoD and IC-developed space systems, especially those systems focused on space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and space situational awareness (SSA)
Expert with IC and DoD processes and protocols for intelligence sharing and collaboration
Demonstrated experience conducting all-source analysis, data and intelligence synthesis, and intelligence analysis and production
Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience preparing executive-level reports, briefings, and intelligence-product publications
Hold an active TS/SCI security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Advanced degree in Intelligence Studies, National Security, National Strategy, Space Systems Engineering, or related STEM with 8+ years of relevant experience
Assignments to various IC organizations, with at least 3+ years at any one
Demonstrated experience working Space Weapons and Tactics
Experience in Red Team methodologies and threat analysis approaches
Participation in Space Warfare games (i.e., THORS HAMMER, Schriever Wargames, Space Flag)
Current TS//SCI clearance with polygraph, and with existing or previous access to SAP/CAP programs.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.
Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.
Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.
Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.
Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.
Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.
Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.
Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.
Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.
Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.
Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.
Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).
Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.
Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.
Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation And Benefits

Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity
Time off: 49 days paid time off
Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans
Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus
Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

London
San Francisco
Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.
Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.
A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.
Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Dry Utilities Estimator/Project Manager is responsible for estimating and managing construction projects from award through closeout while ensuring projects are completed safely, on

schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements and company standards.

This role oversees bidding, estimating, project planning, budgeting, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, client communication, and financial performance.

A primary focus of this role is estimating and managing dry utility projects (gas, electrical, and telecom), with wet utility experience considered a strong advantage.

The Project Manager / Estimator partners closely with Superintendents, Foremen, Accounting, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful project execution.

Essential Job Functions

Perform comprehensive quantity takeoffs and prepare accurate cost estimates for dry utility projects, specifically focusing on gas, electrical, and telecom infrastructure.
Manage the complete bidding process, including reviewing bid documents, analyzing specifications, and attending pre-bid job walks.
Evaluate and solicit subcontractor and supplier quotes for both dry and wet utility scopes of work.
Develop competitive bid proposals and transition successful bids into active project budgets.
Manage assigned construction projects from project award through final closeout.
Develop project budgets, schedules, forecasts, and cash flow projections.
Review and interpret project plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Oversee subcontractor procurement, contract execution, and performance.
Manage project cost tracking, change orders, and financial reporting.
Coordinate project scheduling, material procurement, and equipment needs.
Serve as the primary point of contact with owners, inspectors, engineers, and subcontractors.
Partner with Superintendents to ensure jobsite productivity, safety compliance, and quality control.
Review and approve project billing, progress payments, and job cost reports.
Manage RFIs, submittals, change requests, and contract modifications.
Conduct project meetings, job walks, and stakeholder coordination meetings.
Support project risk management, issue resolution, and claims avoidance.
Ensure compliance with company safety standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate, organized, and complete project documentation.
Support project closeout including as-builts, warranties, final billing, and turnover documentation.
Maintain confidentiality of project financials, contracts, and company business information.
Performs other related duties as required or assigned. Responsibilities may be modified or added based on operational needs and business priorities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
Equivalent construction and project management experience may be substituted.Experience:
5–8 years of progressive construction, utilities, or civil project management and estimating experience required.
Demonstrated experience estimating and managing dry utility work, specifically gas, electrical, and telecom infrastructure, is required.
Experience estimating or managing underground wet utilities (sewer, storm drain, water) or civil infrastructure projects is strongly preferred.Licenses/Certifications (if applicable):
OSHA 30 preferred.
Valid California driver’s license required.

Skills

Strong knowledge of construction project management processes and job cost control.
Strong understanding of plans, specifications, and contract documents.
Strong budgeting, forecasting, and schedule management skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Proficiency with estimating and project management software, specifically Bid to Win (B2W), Coins, Bluebeam, and PlanSwift, as well as Microsoft Excel.
Strong problem-solving, leadership, and decision-making abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional project team.
Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive project and company information.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary to light work in nature. The employee is regularly required to sit for prolonged periods, use hands and fingers to

operate a computer keyboard, telephone, and office equipment, and occasionally stand, walk, bend, or reach. The employee may occasionally lift or move office materials such as

files, binders, laptops, or boxes of supplies weighing up to 20 pounds.

Work Environment:
Work is typically performed in a professional office environment, with occasional visits to field or construction sites as required. The noise level in the office

is usually moderate. The employee may occasionally be exposed to outdoor weather conditions, dust, and construction noise when visiting job sites. All work must be performed

in compliance with Cal/OSHA safety and ergonomic standards, and employees are expected to use proper personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering field areas.

Reasonable Accommodations:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance

with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA).

Culture Alignment

All employees are expected to uphold Boudreau Pipeline’s values of Communication, Mutual Respect, and Accountability. These principles guide how we lead, collaborate, and perform

our work every day.

gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

new_jobs.description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Project Manager, Semiconductor IC Design & Development

Bring structure, momentum, and visibility to complex semiconductor development programs. In this role, you will lead projects across the full integrated circuit lifecycle, partnering with engineering, manufacturing, foundry, packaging, test, and business teams to move products from project kickoff through production release. You will combine disciplined project leadership with enough semiconductor technical knowledge to understand dependencies, anticipate risks, and drive timely decisions.

What you'll do

Build and manage integrated schedules from design and verification through layout, tape-out, wafer fabrication, assembly, test, characterization, qualification, and production release.
Define project scope, milestones, deliverables, ownership, budgets, resources, and development gates.
Coordinate cross-functional activities across design, verification, layout, product engineering, test, packaging, manufacturing, and supply chain.
Monitor critical-path dependencies and lead recovery plans when schedules or deliverables are at risk.
Maintain project risk registers and drive mitigation plans for technical, cost, schedule, resource, supply-chain, foundry, packaging, and qualification risks.
Coordinate design reviews, tape-out readiness, technical action items, and verification closure.
Track wafer starts, fabrication cycles, prototype builds, engineering samples, test hardware, and related material dependencies.
Coordinate silicon bring-up, characterization, reliability testing, corrective actions, qualification, and screening activities.
Track development costs and work with functional leaders to address resource constraints and priorities.
Provide concise project reporting covering milestones, schedules, risks, resources, decisions, and accountable actions.

What you need

Strong project planning, scheduling, risk management, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills - required
Strong written and verbal communication skills - required
Understanding of the semiconductor development lifecycle from specification through production - required
5+ years of semiconductor or technical project/program management experience - required
Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering or a related technical discipline - required
Experience managing multiple complete integrated circuit development programs and working with external foundries and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test suppliers - preferred
Project Management Professional certification, relevant master’s degree, and/or experience with Microsoft Project or similar systems - preferred
Knowledge of MIL-STD-883, MIL-PRF-38535, or other applicable high-reliability semiconductor requirements - preferred

What we offer

You’ll have the opportunity to lead technically complex semiconductor programs end to end, work across multiple engineering disciplines, and directly influence how new products progress from concept to production.

What happens next

Submit your application for consideration. Details regarding interview stages, timing, and candidate communications will be shared as part of the recruiting process.

U.S. citizenship, fluency in English, a valid U.S. passport, and the ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10% are required. An active Department of Defense security clearance may be required.

$103,200.00-$137,600.000

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.
Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.
Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.
Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.
Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.
Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.
Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.
Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.
Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.
Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.
Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.
Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).
Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.
Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.
Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation And Benefits

Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity
Time off: 49 days paid time off
Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans
Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus
Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

London
San Francisco
Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.
Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.
A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.
Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Software Quality Operations (SWQOps) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.

Why This Team Is Essential To Waymo's Success

Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026) and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQ Ops plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. The Regulatory Reporting Operations team within SWQ Ops owns the scaled delivery of datasets and methodologies used to evaluate events of regulatory interest and ensure reporting accuracy as Waymo continues to scale. We are on the front lines of:

De-risking New Deployments: Through meticulous triage of driving and simulated events, issue discovery, and continuous field monitoring, SWQ Ops provides early warnings and critical insights. This "early intervention in RO issue detection" ensures operational resilience and safety, particularly in new and complex environments, which is critical as Waymo enters multiple new cities and ramps up platforms like Ojai.
Enabling International RO & Market Expansion: Our team is deeply integrated into every stage of Waymo's market entry framework, from initial city evaluation (OK2Plan) to scaling operations (OK2Scale). We provide the necessary data analysis, policy development, and quality assurance to unblock critical milestones, preventing slowdowns in market expansion velocity.
Data Flywheel: Supporting the development of a single, automated, end-to-end machine learning flywheel for the entire Waymo Driver. A successful flywheel will be the core engine for scaling our technology, enabling faster international expansion, quicker remediation of driving issues, and a significant reduction in the engineering effort required to maintain and improve the driver.
Driving Engineering Velocity: By handling the vital work of performance evaluation, issue deep-dives, and data set curation, SWQOps collaborates heavily and allows Waymo's Engineering, SysEng, Simulation, and Data Science teams to focus on their core tasks of developing and improving the Waymo Driver.
Workflow Incubation & Development: Incubating high-impact workflows and ensuring readiness for automation and long-term operational excellence.

You Will

Drive outcomes for large and complex technical operations programs that span multiple organizations. Develop and drive execution on strategic roadmaps, own forecasting and resource planning.
Partner with the Regulatory Compliance team to operationalize reporting requirements and be responsible for standing up new workflows and scaling existing workflows to support US and International expansions.
Define program / workflow KPIs and SLAs. Drive high-quality outcomes through deployments with a global vendor workforce.
Drive workflow transformation efforts to meet evolving business needs. Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance.
Communicate overall program status, risks and current priorities to executive stakeholders. Drive strategic decisions making across functions.
Mentor a high-performing team of Technical Specialists, fostering a culture of "quality-first" in a high-velocity environment.

You Have

Bachelor's degree in technical, legal or business discipline
10+ years of experience managing complex, tech-enabled operations and experience working across cross-functional partners (Legal, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Systems Engineering) to drive outcomes
