new_jobs.title: Sr Staff Technical Program Manager – Therapy Optimization
new_jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team

Our Product Technical Program Management team leads Dexcom’s Clinical Products from concept through commercialization. Therapy Optimization
is one of our most exciting areas: Smart Basal, Dexcom’s first digital therapeutic, is a CGM-based program that delivers long-acting (basal) insulin dose recommendations. Programs like this bring together software, algorithm, cloud platform, clinical, regulatory, quality, human factors, and commercial teams in ways that go beyond traditional device development.

A successful Sr Staff Technical Program Manager
is a cross-functional leader recognized by peers and functional leadership for guiding teams from different functional backgrounds and reporting lines. They own program scope, deliverables, roadmap, and schedule; communicate clearly; foster collaboration; keep teams motivated; and drive data-driven decisions that weigh product, platform, and program trade-offs. They have a proven record of leading technical development programs from feasibility to commercialization in the medical device or digital health space, along with the business and organizational awareness to make trade-off recommendations that optimize outcomes for multiple stakeholders.

Where you come in

You will lead Therapy Optimization programs, such as Smart Basal, along with other Digital Solutions programs, from planning and development through verification and validation, clinical studies, regulatory submissions, and launch.
You will lead cross-functional core teams and build integrated plans across Software, Algorithm, Cloud Platform, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Human Factors, Medical Affairs, Product Management, Commercial, and Legal.
You will coordinate synchronized delivery across multiple software releases (app, clinician portal, backend, and algorithm) and align program milestones with broader product and software roadmaps.
You will manage regulatory and clinical timelines, including FDA submissions and EU MDR/notified body pathways, and make sure change-impact evidence and design control documentation are planned and delivered on schedule.
You will identify risks early, drive mitigation plans, and resolve trade-offs among scope, schedule, quality, and compliance, escalating to leadership when decisions are needed.
You will communicate program strategy, scope, deliverables, schedules, status, and recommendations regularly to functional and executive leadership and through governance forums.
You will build a culture of accountability and collaboration by removing barriers, resolving conflict promptly, running retrospectives, and sharing lessons learned across programs.
You will mentor team members and provide candid feedback to them and their managers.

What Makes You Successful

Demonstrated technical program management and leadership of a complex medical device or software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) program that introduced new technology to market, with strong technical, cross-functional, and risk-management leadership.
Experience across software and digital health disciplines such as mobile apps, cloud platforms, algorithms, and cybersecurity, ideally for therapy, dosing, or decision-support products.
Experience with regulatory filings for novel medical technologies through FDA (e.g., 510(k)) and/or EU MDR pathways, and with clinical study coordination.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and be comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, conveying technical and business information clearly in documents, reports, and presentations at all levels.
Expertise with stage-gate product development and/or agile software development frameworks (medical preferred).
Experience managing stakeholders and external partners at all technical and leadership levels, driving critical decisions and resolving competing interests.
Experience in the medical device industry, with proven ability to work within a Quality System compliant with FDA Design Control regulations (21 CFR 820.30).
Training in Six Sigma, design of experiments, and statistical methods is a plus.

What You’ll Get

A front row seat to life-changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required

5–15%

Experience And Education Requirements

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 13+ years related experience or a Master’s degree and 8+ years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 5+ years of experience.

Flex Workplace:
Your primary location will be a home office. You will not have an assigned workstation and will work with your manager to determine office visit needs. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km).

The Opportunity

What’s it like to work at BAE Systems? It’s the feeling of knowing your strategic oversight and analytical precision are directly securing the future of national defense on one of the most complex "mega-projects" in the world.

Our teams provide the critical advisory and assistance services needed to modernize the U.S. ICBM weapon system. Strategic Oversight & Comparison: Conducting comprehensive status comparisons between Prime and Sub-contractor PMRs; analyzing discrepancies in dates and deliverables to ensure alignment across the supply chain.
Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA): Analyzing Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) and conducting SRA to identify critical path risks, relaying findings to stakeholders to prevent program slips.
Logistics & Lifecycle Analysis: Consolidating complex logistics data, including LCSP, aging/surveillance, and spares data, ensuring alignment with production schedules and cost reporting.
Financial Fidelity: Providing cost support for "life of type" buys and long-lead materials, working closely with Financial Management (FM) to increase the accuracy and fidelity of cost data.
Supplier Management: Leading analysis of sub-tier supplier processes and evaluating alternate PBPS suppliers, including the management of RFAs and contractual execution requirements.
Technical Coordination: Consolidating and tracking critical notes, questions, and action items ahead of major reviews to ensure all stakeholders are aligned and accountable.
Sustainment Planning: Collecting and analyzing PBACM "age out" data and Programmed Depot Maintenance requirements to ensure long-term system viability.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned Program Manager who thrives in the "deep dive." You are comfortable navigating the tension between different contractors and can translate complex data into actionable executive summaries. You are a collaborator who asks the right questions and possesses the tactical skill to execute a plan and the strategic vision to anticipate a customer's needs.

Education: Accredited Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, or a related technical field.
Experience: 10+ years of directly related experience (8+ years with a Master’s degree).

Communication: Excellent cognitive, written, and spoken communication skills, with a high level of proficiency in stakeholder facilitation and conflict resolution.
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret security clearance and all necessary Special Access Program (SAP) accesses.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with ICBM Weapon Systems and DoD Product Development Lifecycles.
Systems Engineering: Experience with systems engineering functions, including requirements definition, management, and verification.
Technical Toolset: Proficiency with Engineering/Agile tools such as Cameo, MATLAB, DOORS, JIRA, and Confluence.
Certification: Professional Engineering License or Systems Engineering Certification.

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. The ideal candidate excels at navigating ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large-scale initiatives from concept through operational launch within an Agile/Waterfall delivery environment.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Lead cross-functional commercialization and operationalization initiatives across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Financial Management, Agile delivery teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful delivery of cloud data services
Shape and drive commercialization strategies, integrated program roadmaps, operating models, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans across multiple workstreams
Define and evolve commercialization operating models, governance structures, and strategic roadmaps to support long-term platform growth and service adoption.
Lead the alignment of service, operational, financial, and technical stakeholders to establish scalable commercialization models, service delivery frameworks, and long-term operating strategies
Manage program-level risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and critical decisions while driving timely resolution and executive escalation when necessary

Strong understanding of cloud-based technology platforms, data products, software delivery lifecycles, enterprise operational processes, and Agile/Waterfall delivery methodologies, including Agile planning practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Proven experience leading complex programs involving multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, competing priorities, and organizational change.
Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and execution across technical, operational, financial, and business domains while influencing decisions across multiple organizations.

Consumer Lending Program Manager

Exempt

Director - Consumer Lending Programs

10063

$113,500.00 - $120,000.00 Annually

Hybrid in Sacramento, CA

Who We Are

Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.

Who You Are

You own the end-to-end delivery of consumer lending, third-party origination, and home loan program initiatives, using data, insight, and strong governance to ensure programs launch smoothly, operate effectively, and perform as intended. You clearly communicate business outcomes to technical teams to support solution design and lead cross-functional teams to accomplish shared objectives. You are a trusted partner to leaders, internal teams, vendors, and third-party lending partners who balances innovation, operational execution, regulatory compliance, risk management, and member experience in a highly regulated financial services environment. You proactively solve problems, influence decisions with subject matter expertise, and drive improvements in lending systems, workflows, partner channels, product delivery, controls, and member offering in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and enterprise-level impact.

What You'll Do

Program and Project Management: Lead and guide cross-functional teams to deliver consumer lending, third-party origination, and home loan program initiatives on time, within scope, and within budget. Responsibilities include developing business cases, collecting and documenting business requirements, conducting research, coordinating vendor due diligence, supporting contract review, managing dependencies, ensuring quality user acceptance testing, overseeing implementations, and supporting post-launch stabilization.
Strategy Development: Partner with senior management and business leaders to develop and implement strategic plans, product roadmaps, lending program enhancements, and channel strategies that align with credit union objectives, responsible growth, operational capacity, member needs, and enterprise priorities.
Risk Management and Governance: Work closely with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Technology, Finance, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor risks associated with lending programs, vendor relationships, third-party origination channels, member communications, systems, processes, and regulatory requirements.
Member and Partner Experience: Focus on enhancing member satisfaction, partner experience, and operational consistency through improved lending journeys, clearer communications, streamlined workflows, digital capabilities, and effective support for direct, indirect, third-party, and home lending channels.
Regulatory Compliance: Stay apprised of relevant consumer lending, mortgage, home equity, fair lending, third-party risk, privacy, servicing, disclosure, and financial services regulations. Ensure programs, workflows, communications, and vendor activities adhere to applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and committee or governance expectations.
Resource and Budget Planning: Manage resources efficiently to optimize program outcomes. Plan, organize, direct, and monitor budgetary activity for upcoming projects, vendor work, system enhancements, partner integrations, operational readiness activities, and lending program initiatives.
Performance Measurement: Track, evaluate, and report program status, adoption, operational outcomes, member impacts, partner performance, risk indicators, and benefits realization. Use data-driven insights to identify improvement opportunities and recommend corrective action where necessary.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including internal teams, senior management, members, vendors, third-party originators, technology partners, and external service providers. Collaborate across Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Marketing, Finance, Branch, Contact Center, Servicing, and vendor teams to gather requirements, define specifications, prioritize enhancements, resolve issues, and support successful execution. Act as a subject matter expert on consumer lending, home lending, and third-party origination programs.
Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, digital lending capabilities, regulatory changes, partner models, and market practices that impact consumer lending and home loan programs. Recommend, update, and create programs, strategies, workflows, controls, reporting, and stand-alone applications to support long-term credit union growth and operational maturity.
Team Leadership: Provide guidance and support to project teams, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
Third-Party Origination and Vendor Oversight: Support onboarding, ongoing relationship management, performance monitoring, due diligence coordination, issue resolution, documentation, and maintenance activities for third-party lending partners, fintech providers, origination channels, system vendors, and other external partners supporting consumer and home lending programs.
Home Loan Program Administration: Support program design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization for mortgage, home equity, HELOC, affordable housing, specialty lending, and related home loan initiatives, including system requirements, process changes, disclosure impacts, operational readiness, reporting, and cross-functional coordination.
Consumer Lending Program Administration: Support program design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization for direct & indirect vehicle lending, unsecured lending including credit card, and consumer lending initiatives, including system requirements, process changes, disclosure impacts, operational readiness, reporting, and cross-functional coordination.
Online New Account Program Administration: Support program design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization for mortgage, home equity, HELOC, affordable housing, specialty lending, and related home loan initiatives, including system requirements, process changes, disclosure impacts, operational readiness, reporting, and cross-functional coordination.
Operational Readiness and Change Management: Develop and support implementation plans, training coordination, communication plans, process documentation, procedure updates, launch readiness materials, escalation paths, and adoption support to ensure sustainable program execution.
Represent credit union in contacts with business and trade associations, members, and regulatory agencies. Attend business functions, industry conferences, and otherwise promote the credit union’s image.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualificiations And Preferences

Bachelor’s Degree in related field required or
equivalent work experience
Advanced degree preferred
8+ years of progressive experience in project analysis, coordination, program management, lending operations, product management, or related financial services roles, including at least 5 years directly managing initiatives end-to-end required
3+ years of experience within a financial institution, regulated lending environment, enterprise project management office, consumer lending, mortgage/home equity lending, indirect lending, third-party originations, or vendor-integrated lending programs preferred

Primary Function

Seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to join our security team. The Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) will report to the CISO and is responsible for establishing and maintaining a comprehensive information security program to ensure that information assets are adequately protected. The ISSM leads the effort to manage and mitigate IT security risks and ensures compliance with applicable security standards and regulations.

Essential Duties

Security Program Management: Develop, implement, and manage the organization's information security strategy and policy framework in alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Oversee the implementation of security policies, procedures, and standards to prevent unauthorized access, data leakage, and other security breaches.
Threat Management and Incident Response: Lead the development and implementation of an enterprise incident response plan to address potential security breaches, including detection, analysis, containment, and recovery. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure a timely and efficient response to security incidents.
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with relevant information security regulations and standards applicable to the enterprise: NIST 800-171, ISO/IEC 27001, and CMMC L2. Conduct regular risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities and propose effective mitigation strategies.
System Security Management: Direct and manage the implementation of secure architecture solutions, including network, application, and data security. Monitor security performance metrics and report on the effectiveness of the security program to senior management.
Collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders, including system owners, to ensure security measures align with business objectives and operational needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the CISO, the ISSM will manage and the Cyber Security Team.

Certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), and GIAC Security Leadership Certification (GSLC)are all highly desirable.
Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate the ATO process resulting in certification of computer systems operating in a classified environment.
Experienced working with cross-functional teams to include engineering, IT, manufacturing, and C-Suite.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years of experience in information security engineering or related roles.
Certifications: CompTIA Security+, ISSM Training, eMASS
Strong knowledge of security architecture frameworks, ATO process, risk management processes, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, encryption).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess the potential impact of security risks.

Active current DOW/DOD Secret security clearance.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - Harm Reduction
new_jobs.description:
Harm Reduction Program Manager

Summary:

The Harm Reduction Program Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and operational oversight of all harm reduction programs across St. John's Community Health, including Los Angeles County, San Bernardino County, and any future locations, grants, or initiatives.

Harm reduction is a public health approach focused on reducing the negative health and social consequences associated with substance use through education, prevention, access to safer-use supplies, and connections to healthcare and supportive services.

This position oversees daily operations, staff performance, grant compliance, budgets, and program outcomes while ensuring consistent, high-quality, patient-centered services across all locations. The Program Manager collaborates with internal departments, community partners, and stakeholders to strengthen service delivery, expand access to care, and address the needs of vulnerable populations.

Reporting to the Director of Support Services, the Program Manager is accountable for program effectiveness, continuous quality improvement, and the successful implementation and integration of new programs and funding opportunities.

Benefits:

Free medical, dental, and vision
13 paid holidays annually, plus paid time off (PTO)
403(b) retirement plan with employer matching contributions
Employer-provided life insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Tuition reimbursement opportunities
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Ongoing workforce development, professional training, and continuing education opportunities
Career advancement opportunities, succession planning, and internal professional growth

Qualifications And Licensure

Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Healthcare Administration, Human Services, or a related field preferred; master's degree desirable.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience supervising staff, including performance management, coaching, and team development.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience working in community health, public health, or social services with underserved and vulnerable populations.
Experience in harm reduction, substance use services, homelessness, re-entry, or behavioral health preferred.
Experience managing grants, program budgets, contractual deliverables, and performance reporting preferred.
Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple programs, teams, and service locations while maintaining accountability and operational effectiveness.
Knowledge of trauma-informed care, harm reduction principles, and culturally responsive service delivery.
Strong organizational, leadership, communication, problem-solving, and collaborative relationship-building skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, electronic health records, and data reporting systems.
Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Site Program Oversight: Provide comprehensive operational and administrative oversight of all harm reduction programs throughout Los Angeles County, San Bernardino County, and any future service locations, ensuring consistency, accountability, and quality across all sites.
Staff Supervision and Accountability: Supervise and support harm reduction personnel across all assigned locations, establish clear performance expectations, monitor productivity, provide coaching, and ensure staff fulfill their assigned responsibilities.
Grant and Contract Management: Oversee all existing and newly awarded harm reduction grants and contracts, ensuring compliance with funding requirements, timely submission of reports, achievement of deliverables, and appropriate documentation across all programs.
Program Implementation and Expansion: Lead the planning, implementation, and operational integration of new harm reduction initiatives, funding opportunities, and service locations, ensuring successful program launches and alignment with organizational objectives.
Standardization and Quality Assurance: Develop, implement, and monitor standardized policies, procedures, workflows, and service delivery expectations across all harm reduction locations to maintain consistent program quality and regulatory compliance.
Harm Reduction Services and Patient Care: Oversee the delivery of evidence-based harm reduction services, including supply distribution, overdose prevention, safer use education, community outreach, patient engagement, and linkage to medical, behavioral health, and substance use treatment services.
Budget and Resource Management: Collaborate with Finance and departmental leadership to monitor program budgets, expenditures, staffing allocations, supplies, and resources across multiple grants and locations, ensuring fiscal accountability and efficient operations.
Community Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations, healthcare providers, public health agencies, law enforcement partners, funders, and other stakeholders to strengthen coordination and expand access to services.
Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor program performance, staff productivity, service utilization, patient outcomes, and grant deliverables across all locations. Conduct regular audits, identify areas for improvement, and provide timely updates and reports to the Director of Support Services.
Strategic Leadership and Program Sustainability: Work collaboratively with the Director of Support Services to identify opportunities for program growth, strengthen existing operations, support funding sustainability, and ensure that all harm reduction programs remain aligned with organizational priorities and community needs.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to explain findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience analyzing digital session, behavioural, or customer interaction data is an asset.

new_jobs.title: Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Infinite Global

Infinite Global is an international communications firm specializing in PR, Content & Campaigns, and Crisis & Litigation. Our clients are ambitious, complex organizations that need to engage with sophisticated audiences. We provide the experience, skills and insight to drive brands forward and, in special situations, to deploy strategies to defend clients from reputational risk.

We serve knowledge-intensive firms, with a focus on the legal and financial services sectors. Some of the world’s largest, most profitable and most specialized law firms and financial services firms look to us for a nuanced understanding of their businesses, a clear sense of the kinds of stories that make news, and tested knowledge of when and how to engage the media.

Our unwavering client focus sets us apart and our approach and success earns accolades from our clients and peers. We are consistently named among PR News’ “Agency Elite” and “Top Places to Work in PR” and have been recognized as the “Best PR Firm” by the National Law Journal seven times.

What we’re looking for

A researcher with a year or more of PR agency experience, ready to work with real independence. The Research Analyst plays an integral role in the design, management and execution of primary, secondary and digital analytics research projects that support key clients, strategic initiatives and business development efforts.

You will translate complex data sets and media landscapes into clear, compelling narratives for client teams and senior advisors, delivering nuanced, actionable insights rather than raw output. This is a role for a proactive, intellectually curious contributor who takes ownership of research workstreams, raises the quality of deliverables, and helps push the agency’s research capabilities forward.

Ideal candidates will bring one to three years of relevant research, analytics or communications experience, hands-on command of the major monitoring and social listening platforms, and a working understanding of PR measurement frameworks. Prior experience in a PR agency or professional services environment is strongly preferred.

This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in our New York City office. Candidates must live within commuting distance.

What you’d do

Research and analysis

Lead comprehensive research projects on companies, industries, markets, competitors, journalists and key executives.
Synthesize findings into objective, actionable insights presented in concise, compelling formats, including research reports, competitive audits, reputation analyses and measurement dashboards.
Support the development and refinement of media measurement frameworks, helping client teams define KPIs aligned with communications and business objectives.
Assist in the preparation of new business proposals and marketing materials, contributing research-backed insights that strengthen the agency’s pitch efforts.

Monitoring, measurement and intelligence

Independently manage media monitoring and social listening programs for client accounts.
Analyze news and social media coverage for key metrics, including tone, topic, share of voice, messaging effectiveness, spokespeople and outlet type.
Monitor media outlets, social platforms and emerging channels for trends, developments and insights that affect clients and their competitive landscape; proactively surface opportunities for client teams.
Identify and monitor relevant industry events, regulatory developments and market trends; gather and disseminate intelligence to relevant client teams and executives.
Support the crisis team with real-time monitoring of client mentions and the timely creation of situation reports.

Databases, media lists and tools

Maintain and evolve databases of media contacts, journalist coverage patterns and competitor intelligence; ensure the accuracy and currency of all records.
Build and maintain targeted media lists in support of client pitching and strategic communications programs.
Maintain current knowledge of research tools, platforms and methodologies, including AI-powered analytics tools, and commit to continuous learning as they evolve.

Why we want you

You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
You have one to three years of relevant research, analytics or communications experience; prior PR agency or professional services experience is strongly preferred.
You have strong analytical capabilities and experience working across quantitative and qualitative data sets, with proficiency in Excel and/or data visualization tools such as Tableau or Google Data Studio.
You have hands-on experience with a broad suite of PR and research platforms, including media monitoring tools (Propel, Cision, Meltwater, Mention or equivalents), social listening platforms (Pulsar, Brandwatch, Sprinklr or equivalents), and media databases and news intelligence tools (LexisNexis or equivalents).
You are familiar with AI-powered research and analytics tools, and genuinely interested in how emerging technologies are reshaping PR measurement and media intelligence.
You have a demonstrated understanding of PR measurement frameworks, including earned media value, share of voice, sentiment analysis and audience segmentation.
You know AP style.

What we offer

Exposure across the agency: research touches client counsel, new business and crisis work, so you see how the whole firm operates.
Opportunity to work with leading law firms and professional services firms on a global scale within an international network.
A focus on growth and professional development: twice annual professional planning sessions, regular access to leadership and mentorship opportunities.
Hybrid work schedule; two days in the office with three optional work-from-home days per week.
$175 one-time stipend for your at-home work set-up; $50 monthly stipend for your smartphone contract and a stipend to upgrade your device every three years.
Competitive salary and customizable benefits package including: 100% company paid health, dental and vision insurance coverage; 401k with competitive company match; monthly benefit stipend that can be used for health and wellness, transportation, student loan repayment or charitable contributions; Employee Assistance Program and free annual membership to the Calm app.
Ample time off: 15 vacation days, 10 annual company holidays, nine days paid sick leave, one personal day and an “on call” period between Christmas and New Year’s.
Unlimited paid time off to volunteer and 100% matching of charitable contributions up to $1,000 per year.
Thorough onboarding and training process that extends throughout your tenure with the company.

The current annual base salary range for this position is $56,000-$66,000. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of Infinite Global’s total compensation package for employees.

new_jobs.title: Security Analyst (Entry-Level)
new_jobs.description:
Position Level: Entry-Level

Hybrid Role: Minimum of 2 days on-site in Vienna, VA

Salary: 55K - 75K

ActioNet has an opening for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level Security Analyst to support and strengthen the organization's information security program. This individual will assist with identifying and tracking security vulnerabilities, monitoring security events, supporting incident response activities, administering security awareness initiatives, and maintaining security metrics and reporting.

The Security Analyst will work closely with IT and other business teams to investigate potential security risks, recommend security improvements, coordinate remediation efforts, and track corrective actions. The analyst will also maintain system security documentation and gather evidence for audits and assessments.

This position is ideal for someone looking to develop their cybersecurity career through hands-on experience with enterprise security tools, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, and security awareness programs.

Key Responsibilities:

Vulnerability Management
Conduct weekly reviews of identified vulnerabilities and security recommendations within the Microsoft Defender portal.
Evaluate vulnerabilities and Microsoft security recommendations to understand potential security risks and determine appropriate remediation recommendations.
Research potential solutions and recommended remediation approaches for identified vulnerabilities.
Coordinate with IT to communicate remediation requirements and track implementation efforts.
Monitor remediation progress to ensure identified vulnerabilities are addressed.
Maintain accurate documentation of identified vulnerabilities, remediation recommendations, and resolution status.
Security Monitoring & Incident Response
Monitor the IT Security mailbox for Microsoft Defender alerts, suspicious activity, and user-reported security concerns.
Review and investigate security events to determine potential risks and whether escalation or incident declaration is necessary.
Follow established incident response procedures when investigating and documenting security events.
Maintain incident documentation and supporting evidence in SharePoint.
Coordinate with IT to investigate and resolve security-related issues.
Conduct weekly reviews of Microsoft Defender dashboards to identify ongoing security activities, emerging threats, and potential areas of concern.
Review relevant threat intelligence and communicate potential security concerns to appropriate personnel.
Escalate suspicious activity and potential security incidents in accordance with established procedures.
Assist with planning and conducting incident response tabletop exercises, document lessons learned, and track follow-up actions.
Email Security & Security Awareness
Administer the organization's Ironscales email security platform.
Review and investigate user-submitted phishing emails through the IT Security mailbox.
Analyze submitted emails and take appropriate action within the Ironscales platform.
Assist with administering quarterly security awareness and phishing simulation campaigns.
Monitor employee training completion and phishing simulation results.
Follow up on unsuccessful training or simulation activities and coordinate additional training or required follow-up.
Prepare and distribute security awareness metrics to Quality Assurance (QA) and IT management.
Continuous Monitoring, Security Metrics & Reporting
Support continuous monitoring by assisting with periodic account and access reviews and reviewing system security documentation and control implementation. Document findings and track corrective actions through completion.
Prepare recurring security metrics and reports to support visibility into the organization's security posture.
Maintain reporting schedules and ensure reports are completed accurately and on time.
Compile, review, and communicate security performance metrics to support internal and external audits.
Identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for security improvement.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, OR at least 2 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, IT operations, or security operations. Relevant coursework and certifications will also be considered.
Foundational understanding of information security principles, including vulnerability management, endpoint security, threat detection, and incident response.
Familiarity with Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, and general IT environments.
Basic understanding of networking concepts, operating system security, and common cybersecurity threats.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and investigate technical issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate technical documentation.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and follow established procedures.
Willingness to learn new technologies, security tools, and processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Security certifications, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications.
Familiarity with Microsoft Defender security tools and Microsoft Secure Score.
Exposure to vulnerability management and security remediation processes.
Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, endpoint configuration profiles, and security baselines.
Exposure to software deployment, endpoint configuration, or security hardening activities.
Familiarity with phishing analysis, email security, and security awareness platforms.
Experience with SharePoint, reporting tools, or technical documentation processes.

new_jobs.title: IT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape.

The Program Manager is a delivery partner and governance steward accountable for the end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives from intake through execution to steady-state ownership. The Program Manager leads individual high-impact projects or coordinates a program of related projects that must move together to achieve a shared business outcome.

This role operates at the intersection of delivery discipline and strategic advisory — managing complexity and ambiguity while enforcing accountability and governance across every phase of the project lifecycle. The Program Manager partners with project sponsors, functional leaders, and senior leadership to translate approved initiatives into executable plans, proactively manage risk and change, and ensure outcomes align with firm objectives. As a trusted advisor to the business, this role provides consistent governance, transparency, and execution discipline across all assigned projects, contributing to overall portfolio health, leadership confidence, and predictable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Intake & Initiation

Lead assigned initiatives from formal intake through project closure, ensuring alignment with firm priorities and governance expectations.
Partner with sponsors and functional leaders to define project goals, success measures, scope boundaries, assumptions, and high-level risks prior to execution.
Lead cross-functional teams delivering initiatives that may include business process change, software implementations or upgrades, technology deployment, vendor engagement, or organizational transformation.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, budget, and change impacts.
Ensure disciplined execution across all project phases, including kickoff, planning, execution, stabilization, and transition to operational ownership.

Delivery & Governance

Demonstrate strong financial acumen, effectively managing project budgets, forecasts, and financial controls to ensure initiatives are delivered within approved funding.
Maintain accurate, current project data to support portfolio-level visibility and leadership decision-making.
Prepare and present concise, decision-oriented updates for executive readouts, steering committees, and portfolio reviews — with the ability to engage and advise at the C-suite level.
Identify, monitor, and manage project risks, interdependencies, and constraints across business and technology teams.
Proactively escalate risks, issues, and decisions requiring leadership attention, providing clear recommendations and options rather than problems alone.
Lead scope, timeline, and budget changes in alignment with PMO governance expectations, ensuring impacts are assessed, documented, approved, and communicated.
Influence, negotiate, and build alignment across teams and functions to drive decisions and keep initiatives on track.
Model PMO expectations by maintaining projects that are transparent, well-governed, and portfolio-ready at all times.

Stakeholder Partnership & Organizational Change

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to the business, ensuring initiatives align with firm growth objectives and governance frameworks.
Collaborate to ensure requirements, outcomes, and success measures are clearly defined and validated.
Work closely with Practice Enablement team to develop and implement strategies that promote stakeholder engagement and adoption, reducing delivery risk and supporting successful outcomes.
Facilitate steering committee updates, executive briefings, and cross-functional working sessions.
Proactively identify and resolve project roadblocks, interdependencies, and resource gaps.

Stabilization & Continuous Improvement

Lead stabilization and transition-to-operations activities, ensuring ownership, documentation, and readiness criteria are met before project closure.
Conduct project post-mortems, capture lessons learned, and implement improvements to PMO practices, tools, and delivery approaches.
Identify and evaluate opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the ongoing development of PMO methodologies and standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or equivalent business experience required.
PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience delivering cross-functional initiatives in a structured governance environment.
Experience managing both business-led and technology-enabled projects.
Comfortable with Agile methodologies with the ability to adapt approach based on the needs of a particular project.
Proven ability to partner effectively with senior leaders, sponsors, and C-suite stakeholders.
Experience operating within portfolio review, executive reporting, and decision-making cadences.
Background in a law firm, professional services firm, or similarly complex global organization preferred.
Strategic, analytical, and systems thinker who connects project execution to business outcomes.
Thrives in ambiguity — able to bring structure and accountability to complex, fast-moving environments while exercising sound independent judgment.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to craft and deliver executive-level messaging that is clear, concise, and decision-oriented.
Demonstrated ability to influence and negotiate across teams, functions, and seniority levels without direct authority.
Proactive risk management orientation — surfaces issues early, brings options, and drives toward resolution.
Intellectually curious, with the critical thinking to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Scrupulous approach to documentation, project data integrity, and tool discipline — understands that strong governance infrastructure is what makes portfolio visibility and leadership confidence possible.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools; experience with platforms such as MS Project or equivalent required.

The firm offers a generous total compensation package with bonuses and raises awarded in recognition of individual merit-based performance. The Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional initiatives that advance the Bank's strategic and operational priorities. This role establishes clear plans and governance, aligns stakeholders, anticipates and resolves barriers, and uses influence to drive timely decisions and follow-through. The Program Manager provides leaders with accurate visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and results. The Project Manager applies structured project management and continuous improvement methods to deliver sustainable business outcomes.

Essential Functions

Enterprise Project Leadership

Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex enterprise initiatives from definition through implementation and transition to ongoing ownership.
Translate strategic priorities and business needs into clear project objectives, scope, workplans, milestones, resource needs, decision points, and measures of success.
Manage project scope, schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, communications, change impacts, and stakeholder alignment, escalating matters that require leadership action.
Establish and maintain project governance, documentation, and reporting that provide clear ownership, decisions, next steps, timing, dependencies, and accountability.

Program Governance & Leadership Support

Coordinate priorities, deadlines, decisions, action items, and upcoming commitments across assigned programs and projects.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead recurring project alignment meetings to assess progress, resolve obstacles, address competing priorities, and confirm decisions and next steps.
Partner with leaders across departments to identify new opportunities, interdependencies, and upcoming initiatives.
Build trusted cross-functional partnerships and use influence to align stakeholders, remove barriers, close execution gaps, and sustain momentum toward shared outcomes.
Anticipate risks, resistance, resource constraints, or delays and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions and escalation paths.

Operational Excellence

Design and implement practical tools, templates, governance practices, and workflows that improve visibility, consistency, efficiency, and accountability.
Translate findings and stakeholder input into sustainable process, policy, system, and workflow improvements, including clear implementation and transition plans.
Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational discipline.

Lead process improvement projects using structured methods such as DMAIC, guiding cross-functional teams from problem definition and root-cause analysis through implementation, adoption, and sustained control.

Demonstrate respect for others by fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and professional work environment.
Embrace curiosity by seeking to learn, improve, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
Act with integrity by maintaining accountability, following policies and procedures, and doing what is right for clients, colleagues, and the Bank.
Promote authenticity through honest and forthright communication as well as transparency.
Strengthen unity by working cooperatively across teams, supporting shared goals, and contributing to a positive culture.

Five or more years of progressively responsible experience leading complex, cross-functional projects or programs, including planning, implementation, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and executive reporting.
Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail
Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent initiatives of varying size, complexity, and visibility from initial definition through implementation and transition to ongoing ownership.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, facilitate productive discussions, and prepare concise, decision-ready updates for senior leaders.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, and PowerPoint, and experience using project or work-management tools to maintain plans, risks, decisions, dependencies, and status reporting.
Proven ability to influence without formal authority, build credibility across functions, resolve competing priorities, and drive decisions and follow-through.
Experience identifying process improvement opportunities, facilitating root-cause analysis, implementing changes, and establishing measures to evaluate results.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information, sensitive business matters, and initiatives with broad organizational impact.

Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or comparable project management certification preferred.
